description: This file defines a class 'Reward' in the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Account', which handles the reward points page for a customer account in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for loading reward data, preparing breadcrumbs, managing pagination, and rendering the reward view.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class managing the reward points page, including loading reward data, handling pagination, and rendering the reward view.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that handles the display of the reward points page. Loads necessary data, checks login, builds breadcrumbs, retrieves rewards from the model, handles pagination, and renders the view.
